name: videotools
description: A web application with video tools: seamless loops, image sequences to video, and more

scripts.build:engine: bun build api/_lib/serve.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/engine/videotools-engine-win32-x64.exe && bun build api/_lib/serve.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/engine/videotools-engine-darwin-arm64 && bun build api/_lib/serve.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/engine/videotools-engine-darwin-x64 && bun build api/_lib/serve.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/engine/videotools-engine-linux-x64
